# pantechdynamics_team_membership (Resource)

One member of one team. The member must already be in your organization (invite them in the console). Destroying it takes the member out of the team; they stay in the organization. Admins can add and remove members only; adding an admin to a team needs an owner's API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "pantechdynamics_team" "platform" {
  name = "Platform"
}

# One resource per membership. The member must already be in the
# organization; destroying this takes them out of the team only.
resource "pantechdynamics_team_membership" "ada" {
  team_id = pantechdynamics_team.platform.id
  user_id = "usr_06ggf8abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Id of the team (team_...). Changing it moves the member: out of the old team, into the new one.
- `user_id` (String) Id of the member (usr_...). Changing it replaces the membership.

### Read-Only

- `added_at` (String) When the member was added to the team, in RFC 3339 UTC, to the second.
- `email` (String) The member's email address.
- `id` (String) "<team_id>/<user_id>".
- `role` (String) The member's role in the organization: "owner", "admin" or "member".

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# A membership is imported as "<team_id>/<user_id>".
terraform import pantechdynamics_team_membership.ada team_06ggf7abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw/usr_06ggf8abcdefghjkmnpqrstvw
```
